[EVENT] User is planning a trip to India.  
[EVENT] User attended an evening prayer service at a Hindu temple on January 27th.  
[TEMPORAL] The evening prayer service attended by the user coincided with the full moon.  
[PREFERENCE] User is interested in learning more about Hinduism and its spirituality.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Attending a Hindu temple's evening prayer service on a full moon day (Purnima) is a great way to immerse oneself in Hinduism.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended books to learn about Hindu spirituality:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. "The Bhagavad Gita" - Translations by Eknath Easwaran or Stephen Mitchell are highly recommended.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. "The Upanishads" - Translations by Eknath Easwaran or Sri Aurobindo are excellent.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. "Hinduism: A Very Short Introduction" by Kim Knott.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. "The Hindu Way: An Introduction to the Vedas" by Shashi Tharoor.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. "Autobiography of a Yogi" by Paramahansa Yogananda.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended online resources:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Hinduism Today  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. The Vedanta Society  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Swami Satchidananda's Website  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Hindu Online  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. YouTube Channels like Sadhguru, Sri Sri Ravi Shankar, and Bhakti TV.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended documentaries and films:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. "The Story of India" (BBC documentary series)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. "Hinduism: A Journey Through the Ages" (Documentary)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. "River of Faith" (Documentary)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Practical tips for exploring Hinduism:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Visit Hindu temples and attend prayer services.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Take a yoga or meditation class.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Read Hindu scriptures and teachings.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Engage with Hindu communities.
